name: Fund Order Type 4 Code
definition: Specifies the category of the investment fund order.

BEDB.name: Bed And Breakfast
BEDB.definition: Investment fund order is part of a bed and breakfast transaction.

INVP.name: Investment Plan
INVP.definition: Investment fund order is related to an investment plan (only applicable to a subscription).

PREA.name: Pre Advice
PREA.definition: Investment fund order is executed with specific pre-advice conditions.

STAF.name: Staff Order
STAF.definition: Investment fund order is a staff order.

RGSV.name: Regular Savings Plan
RGSV.definition: Investment fund order is a regular savings plan (only applicable to a subscription).

RGSU.name: Regular Savings Plan Update
RGSU.definition: Investment fund order is paying extra money into to an existing plan (only applicable to a subscription).

RDIV.name: Reinvestment Of Dividend
RDIV.definition: Investment fund order is a dividend reinvestment (only applicable to a subscription).
